page.content:
DUPLO Toolo (Dacta) is a subtheme of Dacta which is the educational division of the LEGO Group. The first sets were released in 1995, and have been periodically released up until 2009.

page.overview:
What is DUPLO Toolo?

DUPLO Toolo (Dacta) is a subtheme of Dacta which is the educational division of the LEGO Group. The first sets were released in 1995, and have been periodically released up until 2009.
